note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000, under the military government of the Chief Executive, not measured data. The army is the dominant institution; the elected assemblies were suspended; religious parties and seminaries, landowners and business groups are influential.

interest_groups.note: The army leadership held executive power after October 1999.
